name: Receiver-local officer-supply necessity and demand gluing
outcome: Each sovereign receiver can prove from its own office and incumbency evidence whether it needs the provider-neutral officer-supply service category, tender that outcome, and let the Union observe agreement among proofs and awards without creating a central staffing authority.
accepts: LocalOfficerSupplyNecessity authored and admitted by the receiver
distinctions: provider observation is not receiver-local necessity
receiver-local necessity selects a service category, not the Academy or another provider
necessity is not a tender; tender is not a bid; bid is not an award; award is not a contract unless receiver law admits it
a supply contract is not recognition, induction, incumbency, appointment, or authority
agreement among local proofs constitutes common demand without constituting a central personnel command
